faqs: Does Paya ever buy without my approval?
No. It simulates, you approve, then it buys. Every payment needs the card holder’s approval.
Can it spend more than my budget?
Paya refuses plans above your budget and checks the exact amount at checkout. A changed total requires a new simulation and approval.
What if the price changes after I approve?
It pauses, re-simulates and asks again. An earlier approval cannot authorise a changed purchase.
What if the deadline passes with no good option?
It buys nothing and tells you why.
Who holds the card and my data?
You attach your card through AgentCard Vault. Card details stay encrypted in the Vault and are used on the card holder’s device. Paya keeps the purchase plan, approvals and merchant confirmation.
What can it not buy?
A purchase must fit your restrictions and a supported checkout. Paya stops when it cannot verify the seller, amount, delivery, terms or payment outcome.

faqs: Will it ever buy without asking me?
No. Every purchase needs your approval.
What if the price or stock changes after I approve?
It re-checks at checkout. If anything differs, it stops and asks again.
Can it go over budget?
No approved plan may exceed the configured budget. Options over budget can be shown as alternatives and are never ordered.
Does it need API access?
Paya can use your existing accounts on supported online shops and marketplaces. Payment still needs a supported AgentCard checkout and the card holder’s approval.
What does simulation first mean?
It rehearses the whole checkout before committing. You approve the real plan, including the final total and terms.
Who sees what it did?
Every step is recorded: options found, simulation, approval and confirmation. The record belongs to the runner or authorised business workspace.

steps: Understand
Turn a text, voice note or photo into a clear brief: what, budget, buying window and delivery deadline.
Research
Check your online shops and marketplaces for price, stock and delivery time.
Compare
Rank options against your budget, offer expiry and delivery deadline. Explain the trade-off.
Build

Simulate

Approve & execute
You approve the exact plan and the card holder approves payment. Paya rechecks, places the order and saves the merchant confirmation.
